data.description: Tackle the day is a fisherman mission you pick up at a Fishing Village or [Large Fishing Village](/monument/large-fishing-village), where you help him retrieve his lost tackle. Head to the coastline, find the tackle box and bring the tackle back to him within the 1 hour time limit. Rewards are a [Handmade Fishing Rod](/items/handmade-fishing-rod), 15 [Grub](/items/grub) and a [Basic Harvesting Tea](/items/basic-harvesting-tea). Fail it and you can retry after 5 minutes; complete it and there's a 1 hour wait.

objectives.translated: Return the tackle to the fisherman
